_readme: FIAT EXPEDITIONS - THE TEST (29 Oct): 6 of the full manifest's jobs (same out, seed, words), one of each kind: a far place, two faces (the youngest and the oldest look), a Bunkhouse strip (the blank cards), the rail icon, a cargo icon. A kept picture is skipped by the full run.

jobs.description: Pixel art, wide side-on panorama, far off and still: a wet seafront promenade curving along a wide bay at dusk, the bay flat and grey, a tall hospital block behind the promenade with every window dark, empty railings and lamp posts unlit. Muted blue-grey and slate palette with sparse warm orange lights, low overcast cloud, dusk. Quiet, not busy; no people in the foreground. The subject sits in the middle of the frame (a card crops a small window from the centre), flat even detail side to side, darker at the bottom edge. Only the palette, light and painting style of the style image, not its subject. The painting fills the whole canvas to all four edges, no border, frame or margin. No text, no signs, no lettering, no numbers anywhere.
jobs._where: the far place swansea: the Expeditions card (centre crop) and the Map's far edge

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art portrait, head and shoulders, of a tired young man under a huge rucksack strap, a plain hi-vis vest with no lettering, a woolly hat, who carries for an expedition crew. Looking just past the viewer. Post-collapse Britain, grey light. One person centred, filling the frame, a clear face that still reads when shown very small. No text, no border, no lettering or badges, plain dark background.

A realistic painted pixel-art portrait, head and shoulders, of an old safe-breaker in a flat cap, a jeweller's loupe in one eye, a cigarette behind the ear, who opens locked things for an expedition crew. Looking just past the viewer. Post-collapse Britain, grey light. One person centred, filling the frame, a clear face that still reads when shown very small. No text, no border, no lettering or badges, plain dark background.

Pixel art, a wide close view: a cork board of blank cream cards pinned in rows, nothing written on them, a road atlas pinned open showing only coloured roads and no names, plain mugs on a trestle table below. Muted blue-grey palette, dark navy shadows, overcast evening light, one or two warm orange lamps. A wide, low strip: the subject sits across the middle, filling the width, with nothing important in the top or bottom eighth (the strip is cropped to fit its box). Only the palette, light and painting style of the style image, not its view or its subject. One continuous scene edge to edge, no border, no frame. No people unless the brief names them, no text, no readable signage, numbers or lettering.

A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a small steel-framed bunk bed, two thin mattresses and a folded grey army blanket on the top bunk, seen from the front at a slight angle, a single bold silhouette that still reads at a quarter of this size, filling the frame, worn and used. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background. No floor, wall, ground or sky around it.
jobs._where: the rail: the Bunkhouse (when it gets a button)

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a small open plain unprinted cardboard box, no markings on it, of mixed medical supplies: plain unprinted foil blister packs, a bandage roll and a small brown bottle with no label, no red cross, no lettering, seen from above at a slight angle, filling the frame, worn and used. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background. No floor, wall, ground or sky around it.
